recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, surrealist studio scene featuring a flat hot-pink wall background, a mint-green header band, and a glossy black floor. The composition includes two levitating bodybuilders, a potted palm, and a stylized reception desk with a masked figure, all rendered with sharp, saturated 1980s color palettes.
coreVisualRelationships: The vibrant hot pink wall acts as a massive field of color against the mint green horizontal band.
The levitating figures create a vertical tension against the horizontal floor line.
The geometric reception desk balances the organic form of the palm tree on the opposite side.
Yellow display typography sits atop the mint band, creating a complementary color pop.
coreInvariants: Flat, saturated hot pink background texture
Levitating human subjects with feet pointed downward
Sharp horizontal division between wall and floor
High-key studio lighting with minimal soft shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two male figures are positioned left-of-center, scaled to occupy the vertical middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, yellow block-lettering at the top serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the top yellow text, down to the levitating figures, across to the desk on the right, and finally to the pink script above the desk.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space provided by the pink wall creates a sense of surreal isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Hot pink (background wall) creates the primary mood and energy.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Mint green (header and desk) provides a cool counterpoint to the warm pink.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow (typography) and glossy black (floor) provide structural highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all hues with high value contrast between the black floor and neon walls.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text is extremely tall and narrow with uniform stroke weight.
Secondary script is thin, monolinear, and mimics neon tubing or handwriting.
Metadata text is enclosed in a thin circular frame.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'M' and 'N' in the display font have very high vertices.
The script 'Bossa' features a fluid, connected cursive style.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A rigid, geometric condensed sans-serif paired with a loose, organic cursive script for a formal/informal contrast.
graphicDevices: Thin circular outline for call-out text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the extreme verticality and bold presence of the header.
Approximates the casual, 80s-style cursive used for the secondary title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio photograph of a hot pink wall with a mint green horizontal band at the top. On the left, a potted palm tree. In the center, two muscular men in swimwear levitating inches off a glossy black floor. On the right, a mint green angular reception desk with white stone textures. High-key lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-condensed yellow sans-serif text across the top mint band. Add a thin yellow circle with small sans-serif text inside on the pink wall. Add a pink cursive script title floating diagonally above the desk.

verificationChecks: Is the pink background flat and highly saturated?
Are the figures clearly levitating without touching the floor?
Is the top text ultra-condensed and yellow?
Is there a clear horizontal divide between the wall and the floor?

adjustableVariables: Specific items on the reception desk
Thickness of the mint green header
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow text is legible against the mint green.
Check that the floor reflection is visible on the black surface.
Verify the palm tree looks like a studio prop.
Confirm the bodybuilders' poses are rigid and upward-facing.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Surreal Studio Photography] + [80s Neon Palette] + [Ultra-Condensed Typography] + [Levitation Motif] to recreate this specific pop-art aesthetic.
